datasets.description: El Salvador Medium Term Projection FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2021. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/el_salvador_medium_term_projection__fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2021]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular monthly surveys across El Salvador to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data were compiled into monthly medium-term projection datasets for 2021, with classifications mapped to administrative units and stored in GeoJSON and KML formats.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys to classify acute food insecurity severity across geographic areas
